paper.title_en: qVocalTract: Efficient encoding framework of vocal-tract spectra on a quantum computer
paper.abstract_en: The vocal-tract transfer function links the physical articulatory model to speech. Quantum encoding of vocal-tract transfer functions requires circuits that preserve acoustic structure under hardware noise. This paper proposes the qVocalTract framework, which uses optimized, ancilla-free staircase layers for spectral loading. Simulations and a superconducting processor compare this approach with sequential matrix-product-state preparation on vocal-tract data. Staircase preparation lowers spectral error and improves resonance recovery, while a modal probe demonstrates coherent processing. The comparison reveals a trade-off between approximation accuracy and accumulated circuit noise. These findings guide practical support for further quantum acoustic processing with physical vocal-tract models.
